name: kara_walk
prompt: Side-view walk cycle facing right, seamless loop. Long confident strides: legs open wide with a bent knee on each step and clear foot contact with the ground, body bobs up and down and sways gently side to side. Red cape and long red ponytail flow behind with slight follow-through delay. She carries the battle axe across her body, swinging slightly with each step. Same framing and same ground line in every frame.

name: kara_attack
prompt: Powerful battle-axe slash facing right. Frames 1-2: guard stance; frame 3: anticipation, she twists her torso back and raises the axe high over her shoulder; frame 4: fast downward diagonal slash with a bright red crescent smear trail drawn on the sprite; frame 5: follow-through with the red trail breaking into sparks; frame 6: axe finishes low in front; frames 7-8: recover back to guard. Ponytail and cape follow the swing with delay. Feet stay on the same ground line.
